analyst.summary: Ashoka Buildcon's extremely low headline P/E is misleading: it reflects large one-off gains from selling stakes in road-asset subsidiaries, not the core highway-construction business, which is actually shrinking (revenue down about 25% in the latest year) with working capital under real stress and zero dividend paid despite reported profits. We do not think the stock is genuinely as cheap as the headline multiple suggests and recommend keeping this a Sell.
